freshness.policy: Every new fixture records exact capture bytes, parent fixture identity, action route, original capture recipe/source identity, current loader identity, and full Plan16 production source closure. A mismatch blocks loading; no automatic rebinding.
freshness.onlySavedAtNormalization: No generated-reproduction claims are made for Plan35 captured checkpoints. If added later, only top-level savedAt may be excluded from strict semantic equality.
